Heard on I.A. No. 12708/2025 which is the third application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed on behalf of the appellant - Rahul for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

02. Appellant has been convicted vide judgment dated 14.03.2022 passed by the learned 15th Additional Sessions Judge & Special Judge (POSCO Act), District Indore in SC-ATR No.
200054/2016 and sentenced as under:
Conviction Imprisonment Fine In lieu of fine 363 of IPC 7 years RI Rs. 1000 1 month RI 366 of IPC 10 years RI Rs. 1000 1 month RI 376(2)(N) of IPC 10 years RI Rs. 1000 1 month RI 5(l) r/w 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 10 years RI Rs. 1000 1 month RI 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention Life imprisonment Rs. 1000 1 month RI of Atrocities)

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the trial Court has examined the scholar register for ascertaining the age of the prosecutrix which was below 18 years but as per the ossification test,
her age is found to be 17-19 years.
Apart from that, it is a case of consent.

As per paragraph 25 of the cross-examination of the prosecutrix, in her biodata she has mentioned the name of the present appellant-Rahul as husband for getting a job and she 2 CRA-3865-2022 worked as teacher for one and a half month.
Further, prosecutrix travelled to Pushkar along with the appellant by changing bus and train but during that period, she never raised any alarm which shows that she was a consenting party.
At the time of incident, appellant was also aged about 19-20 years having no criminal record.
His career would be spoiled if he remains in the company of hardened criminals for long.
Appeal is of the year 2022 and its final disposal will take considerable time.
Hence, in such circumstances, prayer is made for suspension of the jail sentence and grant of bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the application and prays for its rejection.

05. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence filed on behalf of the appellant deserves to be allowed.
06. Accordingly, I.A.No.12708/2025 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal.

It is directed that appellant - Rahul shall be released on bail subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 08.12.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
3 CRA-3865-2022 List in due course.
